name: Cable Depot, Inc
old_description: Cable Depot is a company founded on the principal of hard work, honesty, integrity, dedication and strong relationships. Our spirit is The Spirit of Service. Our goal is to earn our customers trust and keep it for years to come.
about:
Cable Depot, Inc. was founded in 1990 in Norcross, Georgia, on principles of hard work, honesty, integrity, dedication, and strong relationships. The company describes its ethos as "The Spirit of Service," aiming to earn and retain customer trust.

The company manufactures custom and standard cable and fiber optic assemblies, including telco cables, custom molded cables, RF cables, SAS/SATA cables, IDC ribbon cables, and electromechanical assemblies. It offers custom cable design, prototyping, and manufacturing, with over 3,500 standard cable and interconnect products stocked. Production covers copper and fiber optic cable assemblies, harnesses, adapters, and connectivity products, supported by advanced equipment and a zero-defect quality program.

Cable Depot serves the medical, electronics, automotive, telecom, military (Mil Spec), robotics, instrumentation, audio, marine, and industrial markets. Its customers include OEMs, resellers, and engineering firms that rely on the company for data, voice, and video connectivity solutions.

The company emphasizes a rigorous zero-defects QA program, 100% product testing and guarantee, advanced equipment and tooling, engineering and prototyping support, on-time delivery, and competitive pricing as key differentiators.
